title: Office Relocation in Kazanchis: Minimal Downtime Playbook
excerpt: Kazanchis office moves: CBD freight rules, IT and file chain-of-custody, after-hours loading, and office relocation pricing from 45,000 ETB with Active Movers.
content:
Why Kazanchis office moves are different

Kazanchis anchors Addis Ababa’s business district—banks, NGOs, law and consulting firms, and government-facing offices beside high-traffic streets. A move here is a project with downtime cost, not a residential truck-and-boxes job. Active Movers plans phased relocations so staff can work through Friday and restart Monday in the new suite.

Pre-move week checklist

  • Number every workstation and meeting room on a floor plan; assign colored labels to departments.
  • Name an internal move captain plus an IT lead for PCs, phones, and any on-prem server gear.
  • Confirm building management rules for freight lifts, basement loading, parking permits, and after-hours access.
  • Decide phased strategy: Friday night core IT, Saturday furniture, or two-weekend split for large floors.
  • Notify neighbors in shared towers if freight noise affects adjacent tenants.

IT, files, and confidentiality

Bag cables by desk number; photograph rack layouts before disconnect. HR and legal files move in sealed bins with a sign-off sheet at origin and destination. For server rooms or network closets, coordinate timing with your IT vendor—we handle physical move; they handle boot and VLAN checks.

Traffic and truck windows

Meskel Square, Mexico corridor, and Churchill-area congestion can delay arrival. Early-morning load-outs (before 7:00) sometimes beat mid-day gridlock when security allows. Stage trucks where management designates—double-parking on main arteries risks fines and slows unload.

What it costs

Office relocations start from 45,000 ETB for typical floors; larger headcount, packing, and IT complexity raise the quote. Compare our office relocation service, 2026 cost guide, and minimal-downtime checklist. Site survey required for fixed price.

Phased move example

Friday 18:00–22:00: disconnect labeled workstations, move file bins, clear meeting rooms. Saturday 07:00–14:00: desks, chairs, pantry. Monday 08:00: IT vendor boots network while movers place furniture to floor plan. Adjust phases to your lease handover and generator backup rules.

Fixed vs hourly for offices

Open hourly billing punishes gate delays in the CBD. Prefer fixed scope with itemized packing lines—hourly vs fixed · contract red flags.

Post-move Monday

Walk the floor with your move captain: every desk label matches plan, file bins sealed, and IT signs off before staff return. Photograph any building damage claims immediately—management deadlines are tight in CBD towers.
